task_instance: Apply the secret-serialization review skill to a small two-file change: a credential field (shared_secret) added to a dataclass RpcClient (holder) plus a pre-existing tool-tracing function that stringifies every kwarg into a log line (sink), and produce the skill's finding with fix guidance.
evidence: Skill and its two reference files are present and self-contained; allowed-tools are Read/Grep/Glob, all available offline. Built a sample project under sample/app (rpc_client.py holder, tracing.py sink, tools.py caller). Ran the skill's investigation process: Grep found the credential field 'shared_secret' on a @dataclasses.dataclass (no repr=False) and the wholesale sink 'safe_kwargs[key]=str(value)', and traced the caller passing the instance as a kwarg. Empirically verified the leak with python3: str(client) renders shared_secret='hmac-TOPSECRET-123' and the captured log line 'tool_call name=run_lookup args={...shared_secret=...}' contains the raw secret (LEAK_PRESENT True). Verified the skill's prescribed fix (field(repr=False) on the holder + scalar allowlist / type-name on the sink) removes it (LEAK_AFTER_FIX False). Deliverable finding written to finding.md (one high-severity finding in the skill's Title/Description/Evidence/Fix format). Files: sample/app/rpc_client.py, sample/app/tracing.py, sample/app/tools.py, finding.md, result.json.
